title: Heavy rain floods roads, topples trees across Seoul
caption:
A fierce autumn storm paralyzed traffic across Seoul after fallen foliage clogged drainage grates, turning city streets into knee-deep rivers. Meteorologists had flagged the unusual clash between seasonal leaf drop and an intense weather trough days in advance.

Source: Koreaherald - Heavy rain floods roads, topples trees across Seoul
